extra.final_summary:
Average body mass by species (after cleaning, 70 unique penguins):
- Adelie: 3,702.9 g (~3.70 kg)
- Chinstrap: 3,853.1 g (~3.85 kg)
- Gentoo: 5,147.5 g (~5.15 kg)

Data problems found and fixed:
1. body_mass_g was stored as text with one value formatted with a comma ("3,075" in row 20). Converted the column to numbers (no values lost).
2. One exact duplicate row (row 61) was removed so no penguin was double-counted.

Checks performed:
- species labels match the allowed values (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) with no variants or misspellings.
- All body_mass_g values fall within the rules-file range of 2500–6500 g; no negatives or missing values.

Not fixed (not relevant to this question): flipper_length_mm has 2 negative values (-200, -187) that violate the 170–235 mm range, and sex has case variants (MALE/FEMALE) and 2 missing values. These don't affect the body-mass averages.
